name: circuit_city
style_suffix: hyperdetailed, cinematic volumetric light, glowing neon, cyberpunk, otherworldly

registers.name: city
registers.interior: an endless neon megacity at night seen from high above, luminous skyscraper canyons, holographic signs and rivers of light traffic threading the grid
registers.next_target: a glowing green circuit board far below, its copper streets catching the light

registers.name: circuit
registers.interior: a vast circuit board landscape up close, winding copper traces, glowing solder rivers and tiny glassy component towers rising like buildings
registers.next_target: a single dark microchip die glinting at the heart of the board

registers.name: microchip
registers.interior: the mirror-smooth surface of a silicon chip die, endless orderly rows of nanoscale transistors glowing like a buried city grid seen from orbit
registers.next_target: a shining cubic crystal lattice of silicon atoms beneath the surface

registers.name: silicon
registers.interior: an immense three-dimensional crystal lattice of silicon atoms, glassy spheres joined by glowing bonds marching away in perfect diagonal rows
registers.next_target: a single radiant atom swelling huge among the lattice

registers.name: atom
registers.interior: the inside of an atom, soft hazy luminous electron probability clouds billowing like glowing fog around a distant bright nucleus
registers.next_target: a boiling web of quantum foam and luminous filaments spreading into the dark

registers.name: cosmos
registers.interior: the vast cosmic web seen from an oblique angle, irregular glowing filaments of galaxy clusters branching asymmetrically through deep darkness
registers.next_target: a luminous spiral galaxy caught in a shining filament

registers.name: galaxy
registers.interior: the inside of a spiral galaxy seen from a tilted oblique angle, rivers of stars and ragged glowing nebula arms sweeping past
registers.next_target: a single brilliant blue-white star wrapped in flares of light

registers.name: star
registers.interior: the corona of a blazing blue-white star, arcs of fire and solar prominences with tiny planets in distant orbit
registers.next_target: a dark planet on its night side, freckled with glowing constellations of city light

registers.name: planet
registers.interior: a huge planet seen from space on its night side, the curved limb dark against the stars, vast glowing webs of city light sprawling across its continents
registers.next_target: a wide continent blanketed edge to edge in luminous city grids

registers.name: gridland
registers.interior: a whole continent at night from high altitude, an unbroken carpet of glowing city grids, ring roads and neon arteries stretching to the horizon
registers.next_target: one dazzling neon megacity of skyscraper canyons rising out of the grid
